title: Short feedback that tells you where to go next
when: Every result, especially a setup gap or refusal
need: Routine output stays short; failures name the reason, missing fact and recovery. Agents can request deeper structured data without losing required context in a quiet-mode change.
surface: Command feedback, receipts, --help and deeper pointers
gap: Audit the whole refusal → reachable installed guide → successful recovery chain. Do not mistake a reference page’s existence for a usable journey.
